R-13 was already delivered (status reports attribution; its lock at the status test) — cited, not re-implemented. R-15: both CI workflows state which half of the gate a push job runs. Scaffold: thematic breaks are rules for the purpose draft; the CLAUDE.md pointer test is the marker, as migrate uses; the constitution's Amendment section matches its header; an in-checkout symlinked README is read. From STABLE-02 round 3: plan lists only names LENS_NAME accepts.
